main_body: Open wooden rack: a top beam and a bottom shelf/base joined by two side posts, with a thin middle rail. Four weapons stand upright in it.
top_band: Light tan band, rows 8-11, on the upper beam. The lower shelf has a similar light tan band at rows 24-27.
evidence: In a column through the upper beam, a light tan top surface (rows 8-11, about 4 rows) changes abruptly to a darker brown front face (rows 12-13) with a shadow row under the edge. The lower shelf repeats this with a light top (rows 24-27) over a darker front (rows 28-31). The posts and the middle rail sit set back under the beams, so the open frame shows horizontal top faces on both its beam and its base. This matches the green seat and cabinet pattern in the guide.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown, a tint of the wood, which is fine. The wood is only about 3-4 steps: light top, mid, dark front, shadow. The beam tops, posts and shelf front are smooth bands with no grain, knots or speckle, whereas the references carry per-plank, per-tile and stone-by-stone variation. The weapon heads have a little shading, but the main wood body is flatter and thinner than the stall and well references, so it would look sticker-like beside them.
